rows.note: Use this for something that is easy or effective to use.
This is the all-purpose choice when “handy” means convenient or useful in practice.

example.english: This bag is handy to carry around.
example.jyutping: ni1 go3 doi6 ling1 zyu6 hou2 fong1 bin6

rows.note: Use this when an object is conveniently close at hand or easy to reach.

example.english: The book is right beside me, so it’s handy.
example.traditional: 本書擺喺我隔籬，好就手。
example.jyutping: bun2 syu1 baai2 hai2 ngo5 gaak3 lei4 hou2 zau6 sau2

rows.note: Use this for a person who is dexterous or skilled at making things with their hands.

example.english: My sister is handy with her hands and makes beautiful clothes.
example.jyutping: ngo5 gaa1 ze2 sau2 haau2 zing2 saam1 hou2 leng3
